name: Customer KYC identity records (ID document copies; name; address; date of birth)
rationale: FATF R.11: CDD records kept at least 5 years after the relationship ends; assume a ~10-year relationship so ~15y total. Mobile and web clients reach the API over HTTPS.

name: Account ledger and transaction history
rationale: Transaction records kept at least 5 years under FATF R.11; many jurisdictions require 7-10 [VERIFY].

name: Loan applications and credit-check results
rationale: Retention tied to loan term plus regulatory period.

name: API sessions and OAuth2 access tokens
rationale: Hours of lifetime. Control case: the quantum leg must vanish.

name: Payment and mobile-money messages exchanged with partner systems
rationale: Every message is new each year; crosses the internet to partners.

name: Off-site PostgreSQL backups
rationale: Same retention as the ledger; replicated over partly exposed paths; rarely attacked directly.

name: Application-to-database link
rationale: Assumed unencrypted unless configured [VERIFY]. No quantum-vulnerable key exchange to attack.

name: Audit trail of staff actions (contains customer identifiers)
rationale: Regulatory audit retention [VERIFY duration]. Internal network.

name: Reference data (currencies; offices; product codes)
evidence_for_zeroing: Operational reference data is exposed through documented API endpoints and carries no customer information.
rationale: Control case: both legs must vanish.
